newsitem.title: USA: Chaparral Steel says gets unsolicited bid.
newsitem.headline: Chaparral Steel says gets unsolicited bid.

text.p: Chaparral Steel Co said Thursday it has received an unsolicited offer to merge with Texas Industries Inc.
Texas Industries owns an 85 percent stake in Chaparral Steel, it said.
Under terms of the offer, owners of the publicly traded shares of Chaparral Steel would be paid $14.25 per share under a cash merger deal, it said.
Chaparral said its board has appointed a special committee to consider the offer and make a recommendation to it.
No timetable has been adopted by the committee for a response to the Texas Industries proposal, it said.
Chaparral makes structural bar products from recycled steel, which is sells throughout North America.
Dallas-based Texas Industries produces steel, cement, aggregates and concrete products.
